key.name: source-directory
key.description: The music library to read. When empty, the app uses the XDG Music folder (typically ~/Music).

key.name: destination-directory
key.description: Where copied and transcoded files are written (the mounted removable drive, or a folder chosen in Device settings).

key.name: device-uuid
key.summary: Volume UUID used to find the drive after remount

key.name: device-configured
key.summary: True after a device has been selected

key.name: output-format
key.summary: How lossless files are written to the destination

key.name: aac-quality
key.summary: AAC quality preset (FDK VBR 1–5 or CBR)

key.name: skip-existing
key.summary: Skip files that already exist in the destination

key.name: copy-non-audio
key.summary: Copy non-audio sidecar files (covers, cues, logs)

key.name: copy-lyrics
key.summary: Copy lyric sidecar files (.lrc, .txt, and similar)

key.name: normalize-volume
key.description: Apply EBU R128 loudness normalization while converting lossless files so tracks play at a more even volume on the device.

key.name: replaygain
key.description: Measure track ReplayGain and write tags when copying or transcoding. Files that already have ReplayGain tags are left unchanged.

key.name: embed-artwork
key.summary: Embed album artwork in transcoded files

key.name: artwork-max-size
key.description: Before embedding into audio files, images are scaled so the longest edge is this many pixels. 0 keeps the original size. Default is 600.
